As Charles Robinson demonstrates (Robinson 263), this draft must predate those of PU
Act II (spring 1819) in Nbk 11. It begins on the page following Behold, sweet Sister mine,
(Longman ii 423–4, no. 182) to which it relates, and is probably of the same date: late
September or early October 1818 (its inclusion by Mary S. among ‘Poems written in 1820’
is an error). At the top of f. 13 is a jotted reminder of the epigraph for Alastor: ‘the good die
